title: Joins and Table Relationships
description: Combine data from multiple tables using INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and SELF JOIN. Understand how relationships work.
whatYouLearn: What table relationships are and how foreign keys enforce them
How INNER JOIN returns only matching rows from both tables
How LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN return all rows from one side plus matches
How FULL OUTER JOIN returns all rows from both sides, matching or not
When to use CROSS JOIN and SELF JOIN for special scenarios
